title: Destruction of Sodom and Gomorrah

questions.question: Who visited Lot in Sodom?
questions.explanation: Genesis 19:1: The two angels came to Sodom in the evening.

questions.question: How was Sodom destroyed?
questions.explanation: Genesis 19:24: The LORD rained sulfur and fire from heaven.

questions.question: What happened to Lot's wife?
options: She became a pillar of salt
questions.correctAnswer: She became a pillar of salt
questions.explanation: Genesis 19:26: Lot's wife looked back and became a pillar of salt.

questions.question: Where did the angels tell Lot to flee?
questions.explanation: Genesis 19:17: "Escape to the hills, lest you be swept away."

questions.question: What small city did Lot ask to flee to instead of the hills?
questions.explanation: Genesis 19:20-22: Lot asked to flee to the small city of Zoar.

questions.question: What did the men of Sodom demand from Lot?
questions.explanation: Genesis 19:5: They demanded Lot bring out the visitors.

questions.question: What did the angels do to the men of Sodom?
questions.explanation: Genesis 19:11: The angels struck the men with blindness.

questions.question: How did Lot's sons-in-law react to his warning?
questions.explanation: Genesis 19:14: Lot seemed to be jesting to his sons-in-law.

questions.question: Why did Lot hesitate to leave?
options: He wanted to save his wealth
questions.explanation: Genesis 19:16: "But he lingered." The angels had to seize his hand.

questions.question: Where did Lot end up living after leaving Zoar?
questions.explanation: Genesis 19:30: Lot lived in a cave with his two daughters.

questions.question: Who were the ancestors of the Moabites and Ammonites?
questions.explanation: Genesis 19:37-38: Moab and Ben-ammi, sons of Lot, fathered these nations.

questions.question: What time of day did the angels urge Lot to leave?
questions.explanation: Genesis 19:15: "As morning dawned, the angels urged Lot."

questions.question: Why did God spare Zoar?
options: For Lot's sake when he asked
It was too small to matter
questions.correctAnswer: For Lot's sake when he asked
questions.explanation: Genesis 19:21: God agreed to spare Zoar at Lot's request.

questions.question: What is specifically mentioned about the judgment covering Sodom and Gomorrah?
options: The cities, inhabitants, and valley vegetation
questions.correctAnswer: The cities, inhabitants, and valley vegetation
questions.explanation: Genesis 19:25: God overthrew the cities, inhabitants, and what grew on the ground.

questions.question: Why did God remember Abraham when destroying Sodom?
options: God sent Lot out of the destruction because of Abraham
questions.correctAnswer: God sent Lot out of the destruction because of Abraham
questions.explanation: Genesis 19:29: God remembered Abraham and sent Lot out of the overthrow.

key_verse_text: Then the Lord rained on Sodom and Gomorrah sulfur and fire from the Lord out of heaven.
